facts.text: John and his children go to the park a few times a week.

evidence.quote: We go a few times a week. It's great for family bonding and letting the kids run around.

facts.text: John and his children had a great time at the park last weekend, with the children enjoying the carefree joy.

evidence.quote: We had a great time last weekend - they really enjoyed the carefree joy.

facts.text: John and his children all got a chance to try swinging at the park.

evidence.quote: Did everyone get a chance to try it? Glad you're all having a great time!
Yeah, everyone got a chance to swing.

facts.text: John and his children enjoy activities that allow them to make memories together, such as park visits and concerts.

evidence.quote: It's all about making memories together.
I just try to find things that we'll have fun with, like a walk or picnic in the park, or finding events in our town and beyond. Just last week, I found a violin concert that we all enjoyed.
